designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system targets digital creators, technical video producers, and automation pipeline operators working within high-cadence short-form workflows. It synthesizes Google Material Design 3 surface models with the high-utility, dense operational hierarchy of YouTube Studio.

The visual direction centers on deep charcoal surfaces paired with the definitive, high-impact YouTube Red brand marker. Interface elements prioritize zero visual fatigue during prolonged sessions, instant visual parsing of telemetry pipelines (rendering, FFmpeg, transcode progress, AI assist states), and strict content-first display hierarchy. Content cards and video nodes take visual precedence over ambient chrome.

Stylistically, the system utilizes Material 3 tonal elevation and strict state layer tinting, calibrated specifically for high-contrast OLED/dark environments. Accents avoid gratuitous novelty, deploying intentional status hues (telemetry green, Gemini intelligence blue, transcode purple) strictly within compact badges and functional indicators.

## Layout & Spacing

The structural layout utilizes a persistent 12-column adaptive fluid grid for desktop workspaces, shifting to 8 columns on tablet viewports and 4 columns on mobile capture/review viewports.

- **Desktop (>= 1280px)**: Collapsible rail sidebar (72px collapsed, 240px expanded), 16px gutter spacing, fixed horizontal work canvas margins of 24px. Multi-panel timeline and preview layouts maintain independent internal scroll viewports.
- **Tablet (600px - 1279px)**: Icon-only rail navigation (72px), 16px margins, dynamic responsive cards collapsing from multi-row arrangements to stacked inspect panes.
- **Mobile (< 600px)**: 16px outer margin, 8px grid gutters, pinned bottom utility actions for rapid editing, upload tracking, and Shorts format monitoring.
- **Spacing Rhythm**: Based strictly on a 4px/8px incremental rhythm. Micro-telemetry chips utilize `space-xs` (4px) internal gaps, while high-density studio inspection forms utilize `space-sm` (8px) and `space-md` (12px) stack offsets.

## Elevation & Depth

In alignment with Material Design 3 dark theme specifications, physical depth is expressed primarily through **tonal surface layering** rather than drop shadows. Elevating a component shifts its background to a lighter charcoal container token.

- **Level 0 (Canvas Base)**: `#0F0F0F` — Default screen background, grid layout foundation.
- **Level 1 (Docked Structural Panels)**: `#181818` with subtle top/edge ghost divider (`rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)` 1px border). Applied to lateral sidebars, studio headers, and inactive dock shelves.
- **Level 2 (Cards & Active Modules)**: `#212121`. Used for Shorts detail cards, performance charts, and video matrix grids. Shadows are strictly ambient: `0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)`.
- **Level 3 (Floating Controls & Popovers)**: `#282828`. Filter menus, action sheets, contextual batch drawers. Shadow: `0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)`.
- **Level 4 (Dialogs & Critical Previews)**: `#313131`. Modal video inspectors, FFmpeg log viewer overlays, upload queues.
- **Borders & Dividers**: High-density developer viewports require crisp structural definition. Use `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)` for horizontal rules and card separators; avoid heavy saturated strokes.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Brand Button**: High-emphasis action (`Publish`, `Upload Shorts`). Fill: `#FF0033` (YouTube Red); Text: `#FFFFFF` (`label-lg`); Shape: Pill (`9999px`). Hover state: `#EA3323` with 8% white overlay.
- **Secondary Studio Button**: Fill: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)`; Text: `#F1F1F1`; Hover: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)`; Shape: Pill.
- **Subtle / Text Button**: Transparent background; Text: `#3EA6FF` (Secondary Blue); Hover: `rgba(62, 166, 255, 0.08)`.

### Chips & Telemetry Badges
- **Studio Filter Chips**: Pill contour. Dormant: `#212121` surface, border `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)`, text `#F1F1F1`. Selected: `#FFFFFF` fill, `#0F0F0F` text.
- **FFmpeg Status Badge**: Height: 20px; Pill shape; Padding: `0 8px`; Background: `rgba(43, 166, 64, 0.15)`; Border: `1px solid rgba(43, 166, 64, 0.4)`; Text: `#2BA640` (`telemetry-code`). Features a 6px pulsating dot for active encoding pipelines.
- **Gemini / AI Telemetry Badge**: Background: `rgba(62, 166, 255, 0.15)`; Border: `1px solid rgba(62, 166, 255, 0.3)`; Text: `#3EA6FF`; Icon: 12px sparkle indicator.
- **Pipeline Metric Badge (Ssemble/Render)**: Background: `rgba(163, 112, 247, 0.15)`; Border: `1px solid rgba(163, 112, 247, 0.3)`; Text: `#A370F7`.

### Cards & Media Items
- **Shorts Grid Item**: Surface `#212121` with an inner 9:16 aspect ratio thumbnail preview container. Rounded to 8px. Top-right duration chip with `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8)` backdrop. Metadata footer below thumbnail displays high-emphasis title (`title-md`), view count metrics, transcode completion indicator, and a tertiary quick-action trigger menu.

### Input Fields & Controls
- **Studio Text Inputs**: Background: `#181818`; Border: `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)`; Corner radius: 6px; Active state: `2px solid #3EA6FF` border.
- **Checkboxes & Radios**: Unselected: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)` stroke; Selected: `#3EA6FF` fill with pure `#FFFFFF` icon check mark.

### Transcode & Processing Progress
- Continuous progress bars maintain a track background of `#383838` with a 4px track height. Processing state is filled with `#3EA6FF`; finalized video completion transitions fill to `#2BA640`. Error states flash `#FF0033`.

## Colors

The palette establishes an authentic YouTube Studio environment built on dark tonal containers rather than absolute black, reserving pure `#000000` for video canvas zones and negative space.

### Functional Roles
- **Primary (`#FF0033` / `#EA3323`)**: YouTube Signature Red. Reserved strictly for primary callouts, recording states, active publishing triggers, and key brand anchors. Never applied across expansive surface backgrounds.
- **Secondary (`#3EA6FF`)**: Studio Action Blue / Gemini Intelligence. Directs interactive text buttons, verified telemetry chips, active tabs, AI-assisted tooling, and standard hyperlink states.
- **Tertiary (`#2BA640`)**: Telemetry Emerald. Designates FFmpeg hardware encode active status, processing completion, live stream health, and monetization clearance.
- **Accent Purple (`#A370F7`)**: Pipeline / Ssemble synthesis pipelines, dynamic effects rendering, and specialized creator tools.
- **Neutral Canvas (`#0F0F0F`)**: Core canvas base.
- **Surface Containers**:
  - `surface-container-low`: `#181818` (Sidebar panels, dormant toolbars)
  - `surface-container`: `#212121` (Standard cards, modal surfaces)
  - `surface-container-high`: `#282828` (Hover states, elevated utility drawers)
  - `surface-container-highest`: `#383838` (Divider lines, inactive pill boundaries, tooltips)
- **Content Contrast**:
  - High Emphasis: `#F1F1F1`
  - Medium Emphasis: `#AAAAAA`
  - Disabled / Structural: `#717171`

## Typography

Typography balances readability in high-density tables with industrial legibility in telemetry bars.

- **Primary Canvas (`Roboto Flex`)**: Powers general product UI, headlines, metric cards, and layout descriptions. Utilizes standard optical sizing to preserve legibility in dark mode across all weights.
- **Technical & Utility (`Inter`)**: Applied across micro-copy, chips, video timestamp badges, FFmpeg transcode flags, and data grid column keys. Inter’s tall x-height and distinct numerals prevent ambiguous readings during live telemetry streaming.
- **Numbers & Metrics**: Numerical representations inside operational badges and frame counters must display with tabular lining figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) to prevent layout jitter during realtime updates.

- **Pills (`rounded-full` / `9999px`)**: Interactive filter chips, telemetry indicators, status pills, playhead buttons, and secondary badges.
- **Cards and Dialogs (`rounded-xl` / `12px`)**: Shorts video cards, metric charts, contextual inspector blocks.
- **Inputs and Code Blocks (`rounded-md` / `6px` to `8px`)**: High-density property textboxes, transcode terminal panels, and audio waveforms.
